name: pgvector (PostgreSQL extension)
description: Self-operated PostgreSQL vector extension. This item describes extension software, not a hosted database offering. PostgreSQL hosting, storage and operations have separate costs. Index/type-specific dimensional limits remain in the linked research note; no universal max_dimensions or ACL guarantee is asserted.

provenance.notes: Tag v0.8.7 resolves to f37c13f68b57d2c3472b2214fbcff699d6d34876. Source checked, no installation or runtime benchmark performed.

Published PostgreSQL extension supports L2 (mapped to euclidean), inner product (dot), and cosine distance. SQL <#> returns negative inner product for ascending ordering; consumers must preserve that sign convention. Schema list is limited to its three supported vocabulary values, not an exhaustive product metric list. README requires PostgreSQL 13+.

PostgreSQL license grants use, copying, modification and distribution for any purpose without fee, conditional on preserving the required notices/disclaimers. This supports free extension-software billing and software-use flags only; it does not grant rights to hosted services, embeddings or customer data.
